themes_detail.label: Park Rule Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Park rule violations exploded to 6 complaints last week—a 2,300% spike versus the 8-week average of 0.2 complaints per week—suggesting a sudden shift in park use, enforcement, or both in Riverdale/Fieldston this week.
evidence: 6 park rule violation complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 13.28)
Represents first meaningful spike in this category in recent baseline period
Community board has repeatedly requested park upgrades and maintenance equipment, suggesting pre-existing park conditions concerns
reporting_angles: What specific park rules are being violated? Interview Parks Dept. and identify the affected parks.
Is this tied to seasonal recreation patterns, new activities (e.g., sports leagues), or lack of enforcement?

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints jumped to 71 last week, a 306% spike from the 8-week average of 17.5 complaints per week, marking the highest non-residential noise spike in the district this week.
evidence: 71 street/sidewalk noise complaints last week vs. 17.5 weekly average (z-score: 3.96)
Street noise is now 3rd largest complaint type in district overall (351 complaints over 90 days), but this spike is new
Community board lists 'improve traffic and pedestrian safety' as standing budget request, indicating ongoing street-level disruption concerns
reporting_angles: Map the complaints: Are they concentrated on specific avenues or corridors (e.g., Broadway, Independence Ave.)? What construction or traffic changes happened this week?
Talk to residents in high-complaint areas about noise sources: construction, traffic, outdoor dining, events.

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Detection Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Three asbestos complaints filed last week—an 1,100% spike from the 8-week average of 0.2 complaints per week—suggesting either new demolition/renovation activity or heightened awareness of hazardous materials in buildings this week.
evidence: 3 asbestos complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.35)
328 DOB building permits filed in past 90 days (204 alterations, 68 new buildings), indicating active construction/renovation season
First notable asbestos spike in recent baseline, coinciding with heavy alteration permit activity
reporting_angles: Cross-check the 3 complaints with DOB permits: which buildings are involved and what renovation work triggered asbestos concerns?
Interview NYC Department of Environmental Protection about asbestos disclosure requirements for contractors; are homeowners and tenants being notified?

themes_detail.label: Encampment and Derelict Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 4 last week (540% above the 0.6 weekly average), while derelict vehicle complaints hit 26 two weeks ago (154% spike from 10.2 average), reflecting deteriorating street conditions and possible homelessness uptick in the district over the past 2 weeks.
evidence: 4 encampment complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 3.94)
26 derelict vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 10.2 weekly average (z-score: 3.72)
10 safety complaints 2 weeks ago (196% spike from 3.4 average), suggesting correlated street disorder concerns
reporting_angles: Boots-on-ground reporting: Where are the encampments located? Interview nearby residents and business owners about impact on quality of life.
NYPD and Sanitation Dept. follow-up: What is the response timeline for encampment removal and vehicle towing? Are there gaps in enforcement?

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Enforcement Gap
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints spiked to 8 two weeks ago (433% above the 1.5 weekly average), suggesting residents perceive degraded street maintenance or missed collection cycles in Riverdale/Fieldston over the past 2 weeks.
evidence: 8 street sweeping complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.33)
Illegal parking (3,233 complaints over 90 days) and curb condition (4 complaints 2 weeks ago, 300% spike) suggest overlapping street infrastructure issues
Community board requests park equipment and street improvements, indicating standing maintenance concerns
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Sanitation: Were there service disruptions, holiday schedules, or staffing changes 2-3 weeks ago in CD208?
Identify complaint hotspots: Are sweeping issues concentrated in commercial areas, residential blocks, or near parks?
